# Contents and completion notes: blank specimen

1. Scope of the instruction — paragraph 1
2. Documents to be checked — paragraph 2
3. Completion and retention — paragraph 3

## 1. Scope of the instruction

The completed instruction must be supplied separately before any signature is requested.

## 2. Documents to be checked

The reviewer should compare the list of documents with the physical or electronic set supplied. A missing attachment must be recorded rather than replaced by an empty page that might later be mistaken for a verified original. The number of pages and the number of documents should be stated separately.

## 3. Completion and retention

The final copy must preserve a record of approved changes. A production comment may remain as a footnote if the approved version requires it, but it must not be represented as a pending tracked revision.
